name: Christmas Cruizer 1.0
author: Dhananjay2981
description:
Welcome to the wonderful world of our Christmas-themed car game! In this 
game, the driver of a car is on a mission to collect a fixed number of gifts and 
deliver them to their designated destinations, all while navigating through 
challenging terrains filled with obstacles. 
As the player journey through the winter wonderland, he will encounter 
adorable snowmen and mischievous devils, both of which will try to impede his 
progress. The snowmen will appear in his path, and if he hits them, his car's 
health will decrease. Meanwhile, the devils will follow the player, causing 
damage to your vehicle. 
With each level, the challenge intensifies, but so do the rewards. The player will 
discover health boxes along the way that replenishes his health, helping him to 
overcome the obstacles that lie ahead. 
As the player explores the enchanting winter landscape, he will encounter 
breath-taking scenes of snow-covered mountains, picturesque towns, and 
forests. The game's soundtrack is filled with festive holiday tunes that will 
transport the player to a world of holiday cheer.
